ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing used by the sequencer and synchronizer processes; drives updates of the shift registers and the registered output signals each clock edge.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used in both sequencer and synchronizer processes for the assignments to sreg_* and the outputs

ports.name: rstn_ext_i
ports.functionality: Active-low external reset that immediately forces internal shift registers and outputs to zero when asserted; it controls the reset branches in both sequencer and synchronizer processes.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_ext_i = '0') then ... in both sequencer and synchronizer processes (reset branch)

ports.name: rstn_wdt_i
ports.functionality: Active-low watchdog reset input participates in the sequencer branch that clears sreg_sys when asserted, and is sampled/synchronized to produce xrstn_wdt_o on the clock.
ports.evidence: used in if (rstn_wdt_i = '0') or (rstn_dbg_i = '0') then ... (sequencer) and xrstn_wdt_o <= rstn_wdt_i (synchronizer)

ports.name: rstn_dbg_i
ports.functionality: Active-low debug reset input participates in the sequencer branch that clears sreg_sys when asserted, and is sampled/synchronized to produce xrstn_ocd_o on the clock.
ports.evidence: used in if (rstn_wdt_i = '0') or (rstn_dbg_i = '0') then ... (sequencer) and xrstn_ocd_o <= rstn_dbg_i (synchronizer)

ports.name: rstn_ext_o
ports.functionality: Output reflects an AND-reduction of the external reset shift register (sreg_ext) each clock; when rstn_ext_i is asserted the output is forced '0' by the reset branch, exporting the extended external reset state.
ports.evidence: rstn_ext_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_ext) in sequencer rising_edge branch; rstn_ext_o <= '0' in rstn_ext_i='0' reset branch

ports.name: rstn_sys_o
ports.functionality: Output reflects an AND-reduction of the system reset shift register (sreg_sys) each clock; it is forced '0' when external reset is asserted, exporting the generated system reset.
ports.evidence: rstn_sys_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_sys) in sequencer rising_edge branch; rstn_sys_o <= '0' in rstn_ext_i='0' reset branch

ports.name: xrstn_wdt_o
ports.functionality: Clocked output that copies rstn_wdt_i on each rising edge (synchronizes it) and is forced '0' during external reset; exports the synchronized watchdog reset signal.
ports.evidence: xrstn_wdt_o <= rstn_wdt_i in synchronizer rising_edge branch; xrstn_wdt_o <= '0' in rstn_ext_i='0' reset branch

ports.name: xrstn_ocd_o
ports.functionality: Clocked output that copies rstn_dbg_i on each rising edge (synchronizes it) and is forced '0' during external reset; exports the synchronized debug reset signal.
ports.evidence: xrstn_ocd_o <= rstn_dbg_i in synchronizer rising_edge branch; xrstn_ocd_o <= '0' in rstn_ext_i='0' reset branch

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing for the ticker process; sequences updates of en, cnt and cnt2 on rising_edge(clk_i) so registers update synchronously to this clock.
ports.evidence: process sensitivity and elsif rising_edge(clk_i) then in ticker process (process(rstn_i, clk_i) ... elsif rising_edge(clk_i)).

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: When asserted low it immediately drives the reset branch of the ticker process, clearing en, cnt and cnt2; it governs the assignments that set those registers to zero.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... assignments to en, cnt, cnt2 in ticker process (reset branch).

ports.name: enable_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the enable vector that is reduced (or_reduce_f) and captured into en on clock edges; feeds en so external enables gate counting.
ports.evidence: en <= or_reduce_f(enable_i) inside ticker process on rising_edge(clk_i).

ports.name: clk_en_o
ports.functionality: Exports combinational one-cycle pulses derived from transitions of selected cnt bits (cnt(i) and not cnt2(i)); provides these pulses to downstream logic as clk_en_o vector bits.
ports.evidence: concurrent assignments like clk_en_o(...) <= cnt(i) and (not cnt2(i)) for bits 0,1,2,5,6,9,10,11.

signals.name: sreg_sys
signals.functionality: 4-bit shift register captured on clk_i that shifts in '1' each cycle when not cleared; it is cleared to zeros when external reset, watchdog reset, or debug reset conditions occur and drives rstn_sys_o via an AND reduction.
signals.evidence: sreg_sys <= (others => '0') in rstn_ext_i reset and when (rstn_wdt_i='0') or (rstn_dbg_i='0'); else sreg_sys <= sreg_sys(sreg_sys'left-1 downto 0) & '1' (sequencer rising_edge)

signals.name: sreg_ext
signals.functionality: 4-bit shift register captured on clk_i that shifts in '1' each cycle when not externally asserted; it is cleared to zeros by external reset and its AND-reduction drives rstn_ext_o.
signals.evidence: sreg_ext <= (others => '0') in rstn_ext_i reset; else sreg_ext <= sreg_ext(sreg_ext'left-1 downto 0) & '1' and rstn_ext_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_ext) (sequencer)

signals.name: en
signals.functionality: Captured each rising clock as the reduction of enable_i (or_reduce_f(enable_i)). When '1' it enables cnt increments; reset clears it to '0'.
signals.evidence: en <= or_reduce_f(enable_i) and if (en = '1') then cnt <= ... inside ticker process (rising_edge branch).

signals.name: cnt
signals.functionality: When en='1' increments by unsigned(cnt)+1 each clock, else resets to zero; its bits are used to generate clk_en_o pulses and it is copied into cnt2 each cycle.
signals.evidence: cnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(cnt) + 1) (increment) and cnt <= (others=>'0'); cnt2 <= cnt; concurrent uses cnt(i) in clk_en_o assignments.

signals.name: cnt2
signals.functionality: Captured each rising clock with the prior value of cnt (cnt2 <= cnt); reset clears it. Used with cnt to detect rising edges for clk_en_o pulses.
signals.evidence: cnt2 <= cnt in ticker process; concurrent uses cnt2(i) in clk_en_o assignments for bits 0,1,2,5,6,9,10,11.
